facts.fact: GovStack says a five-day workshop in Nouakchott from 28 September to 2 October 2026, with MTNIMA, covered architecture, user experience, interface design and change management for senior and middle management and 120 recently recruited public servants.

GovStack says more than 30 representatives of the Ministries of Justice, Transport, Finance and Digital Transformation took part in a five-day ITU and Kitsoft low-code service-development workshop in 2025.
